summary: Staging | DataDog log limit | Massive ShiftOPVariableContainer Logs

fix_pr.title: SCH-22428: Remove excessive invalid shift logging

rca.problem_statement: The forac enterprise on staging generated 2.2M log entries in Datadog from ShiftOPVariableContainer.createDailyShift() due to info-level logging on a high-frequency optimization hot path
rca.root_cause: Inappropriate log level (info) on a high-frequency code path — every rejected invalid shift was logged during optimization
contributing_factors: 6AM-6AM operating hours configuration creating dead zone with always-rejected start times
Secondary start-time paths checking businessEndMinutes instead of capped dayEnd
Scale multiplier: worker × day × role × duration × 8+ weeks
rca.trigger: Guidance refresh on forac enterprise with 6AM-6AM operating hours

classification.escape_reason: No log volume testing for edge-case configurations

five_why: 2.2M logs generated → Every rejected shift logged at info level
So many rejections → 6AM-6AM config created dead zone with invalid start times
Invalid start times generated → Secondary path checks businessEndMinutes not dayEnd
logger.info() used → Added for debugging, never adjusted for production volume
Not caught earlier → No performance/log-volume testing for optimizer hot paths
recommendations: Add log-level review gate for optimizer hot paths
Add Datadog log volume alerts (>100K entries/hour)
Use logger.debug()/trace() for expected validation failures
Add performance test for edge-case operating hours configurations
